title: Compare runs
description: The same task, started in a worktree of its own each time. Open a run to keep working on it; nothing here merges or deletes anything.
elsewhere_hint: Its start was sent before this page reloaded. It shows here once its session appears.
stopped_retry: It stopped before it started. Retry starts it now.
stopped_gone: This page reloaded before it started, so the task is no longer here. Start it again from New agent.
uncertain: The hub couldn't say whether it started. Open it to decide.
not_found_body: Comparisons are kept in the browser that started them, the latest 20 only.
